ṛgveda:
he ṛtvijaḥ yūyaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya mitrāvaruṇayoḥ cakṣase draṣṭe mahaḥ mahate devāya dyotamānāya dūredṛśe dūre saptamapi dṛśyate devajātāya deveṣu jātāya ketave viśvasya prajñāpakāya divaḥ putrāya putrabhūtāya |
divi jāyamānatvāt tatputratvavyapadeśaḥ |
sūyāṃ sūryārthaṃ namaḥ kṛtvā tat vihitam ṛtaṃ yāgādilakṣaṇaṃ karma maparyata pūjayata |
śaṃsata stutimapi kuruta ||
mā mā satyoktiḥ pari pātu viśvato dyāvā ca yatra tatanurhahāni ca |
viśvamanyanni viśate yadejati viśvahāpo viśvahādeti sūryaḥ ||

sā | mā | satya'uktiḥ | pari | pātu | viśvataḥ | dyāvā | ca | yatra | tatanur | ahāni | ca | viśvam | anyat | ni | viśate | yat | ejati | viśvahā | āpaḥ | viśvahā | ut | eti | sūryaḥ || 2 ||
sā satyoktiḥ tatsatyavacanaṃ mā māṃ viśvataḥ sarvataḥ pari pātu rirakṣatu |
yayā satyoktyā yatra yasmin deśe dyāvā ca dyāvāpṛthivyau ahāni rātrayaḥ ca tatanur atanvan tatra viśvaṃ sarvam anyat bhūtajātaṃ ni viśate viśrāmyati |
yat etadbhūtajātam ejati kampate viśvahā sarvadā |
āpaḥ ca syandante viśvahā sarvadā sūryaḥ ca udeti |
sā satyoktimāṃ paripātvityarthaḥ ||
na te adevaḥ pradivo ni vāsate yadetaśobhiḥ paturai ratharyasiṃ |
prācīnamanyadanu vartate raja udanven jyotiṣā yāsi sūrya ||

ṛgveda:
vindrasya vsumukhaṃ suṣṭhu saṃhanīyaṃ vsahaḥ balaṃ vmahi mahat vśravaḥ annaṃ vnṛmṇaṃ sukhaṃ vca vrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau vsaparyataḥ pūjayataḥ |
tasmā indrāya prācaiti samanvayaḥ ||
so cinnu sakhyā narya inaḥ stutaścarkṛtya indro māvate narai |
viśvāsu dhūrṣu vājakṛtyeṣu satapate vṛtre vāpsvabhi śūra mandase ||
2 ||
saḥ | cit | nu | sakhyā | naryaḥ | inaḥ | stutaḥ | carkṛtyaḥ | indraḥ | māvate | narai | viśvāsu | dhūrṣu | vājakṛtyeṣu | satapate | vṛtre | vā | apsu | abhi | śūra | mandase || 2 ||
vso vcinnu sa khalu vindraḥ vsakhyā sakhibhūtena nimittena vnaryaḥ nṛbhyo hitaḥ vinaḥ sarvasyeśvaraḥ vstutaḥ sarvairabhiṣṭutaḥ |
sakhyā stuta iti vā saṃbandhaḥ |
vmāvate matsadṛśāya vnare narāya vcarkṛtyaḥ punaḥpunaḥ kartavyaḥ |
paricaraṇīya ityarthaḥ |
atha pratyakṣavādaḥ |
he vsatapate satāṃ pālakandra sa tvaṃ vviśvāsu sarvāsu vdhūrṣu voḍhavyeṣu kāryabhāreṣu vvājakṛtyeṣu ca balakṛtyeṣu ca vvṛtre vvāpsu meghe vartamāneṣūdakeṣu ca nimitteṣu he vśūra tvam vabhi vmandase abhiṣṭūyase ||
ke te nara indra ye ta iṣe ye teṃ sumnaṃ sadhanvyamiryakṣān |
ke te vārjāyāsuryāya hinvire ke apsu svāsurvarāṃsu pauṃsyai ||
3 ||
ke | te | naraḥ | indra | ye | te | iṣe | ye | te | sumnam | sadhanvyam | iryakṣān | ke | te | vājāya | asuryāya | hinvire | ke | apsu | svāsu | urvarāsu | pauṃsyai || 3 ||
he vindra vte vnaraḥ ke manuṣyā iti praśnaḥ |

2. ta-bha1.2.4.6.8- ‘ haraḥ ’ nāsti |

atra vājasaneyakaṃ - 'yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyastriyugaṃ puretyatro vai devāstebhya etābhiḥ purā jāyante vasante prāvṛpi śaradi manai nu babhrūṇāmahamiti somo vai babhruḥ somyā oṣadhaya auṣadhaḥ puruṣaḥ śataṃ dhāmānīti yadidaṃ śatāyuḥ śatārhaḥ śatavīrya etāni hāsya tāni śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ceti|
ya eteme sapta śīrṣanprāṇāstānetadāha' (śa. brā. 7. 2. 4. 26) iti|
atra niruktaṃ ca - 'yā oṣadhayaḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyarṇī yugāmi purā manye nu tadvabhrūṇāmahaṃ bharaṇānāṃ haraṇā- nāmiti vā śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ceti|

‘bṛhaspate prati’ iti dvādaśarcamaṣṭamaṃ sūktaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ bṛhaspatimitrādisarvadevatākam |
ṛṣipeṇa- putro devāpirnāmarṣiḥ |
tathā cānukāntaṃ—‘bṛhaspate dvādaśārṣipeṇo devāpirṛṣṭikāmo devāṃsatuṣṭāva’ |
gataḥ sūktaviniyogaḥ |
asya sūktasyārthaṃ nihakkāraḥ pradarśayati—‘devāpiśvāṣṭipeṇaḥ śaṃtanuśca kauravyau bhrātarau babhūvatuḥ |
sa śaṃtanuḥ kanīyānabhiṣecyāṃcakre devāpistapaḥ pratipede |
tataḥ śaṃtano rājye dvādaśa varṣāṇi devo na vavarṣa |
tamūcurbrāhmaṇā adharmasavayā carito jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramantarityā- bhiṣecitaṃ tasmātte devo na varṣatīti |
sa śaṃtanurdevāpiṃ śiśikṣa rājyena |
tamuvāca devāpiḥ |

yatra kvacit pāṭhaviṣaya āśaṅkāsīttatra kāśmīrapustakakamapi mayāvalokitam|
yatra kāśmīrapustakasthaṃ pāṭhaṃ tyaktvā śuddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ sādhāraṃ taiḥ svīkṛtaḥ aśuddhaḥ pāṭhaśca ṭippaṇyāṃ nirdiṣṭa- statra tādṛśo'śuddhaḥ pāṭho mayā na nirdiṣṭaḥ|
keṣucitsthaleṣvaśuddhaṃ pāṭhaṃ khile tathaiva sthāpayitvā śuddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ taiḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ saṃsūcitaḥ|
etādṛśāḥ kecana sūcitāḥ pāṭhā viśeṣataḥ sauparṇasūktagatā mayā mūle viniveśitāḥ|
pāṭhaviniścitiṃ varjayitvānye'pi kecana viṣayāsteṣāṃ ṭippaṇīpāgatārate tatraiva draṣṭavyāḥ|
kvacit likhitapustakasthamaśuddhaṃ pāṭhaṃ tyaktvā mudritapustakādhāreṇa likhitapustakādhāreṇa vā śuddhaḥ pāṭho mayā svīkṛtaḥ|
e. bī. kīthamamahāśayaiḥ kāśmīrakhilagranthavimarśasamaye trayaḥ śuddhāḥ pāṭhāḥ saṃsūcitāste'tra svīkṛtāḥ|
khilānāṃ ṭippaṇyo mayā saṃskṛtabhāṣāyāmeva likhitāḥ|
lekhanasaṃkṣepasiddhayarthaṃ kāniciccihnāni prayuktāni tāni saṃkṣepavivaraṇe pradarśitāni|
ṭippaṇīlekhane tāvadayaṃ kramaḥ svīkṛtaḥ - (1) adhyāyasyānukramaṇī adhyāyasyādau dattā|
anukramaṇīpāṭhabhedā apyatraiva nirdiṣṭāḥ|
(2) ṛgvedasaṃhitāyāṃ khilaṃ yatra paṭhanīyaṃ tasya sthānasya nirdeśaḥ|
(3) yeṣu yeṣu grantheṣu khilaṃ pūrṇatayāṃśato vā mudritaṃ teṣāṃ nāmanirdeśaḥ|
(4) yeṣu yeṣu vaidikagrantheṣvitaragrantheṣu ca khilaṃ pūrṇatvenāṃśato vā mantrakramabhedena pāṭhabhedena vāgataṃ teṣāṃ nāmādinirdeśaḥ|
(5) mantrakrameṇa pāṭhabhedanidarśanam|
svīkṛtapāṭhaḥ sthūlākṣaraiḥ prathamaṃ vinyastaḥ|
tadādhāra- bhūtagranthanāmabhiḥ saha|
anantaraṃ pāṭhabhedāstattadgranthanirdeśena dattāḥ|
yatra svīkṛtapāṭhasyādhāro na pradarśitaḥ pāṭhabhedasyādhāraścālpaḥ tatra svīkṛtapāṭhādhārasya balīyastvānirdeśo na kṛta iti mantavyam|
(6) mudritakhilapustakeṣu itaragrantheṣu ca vidyamānā adhikā mantrāḥ|
(7) adhikānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ pāṭhabhedāḥ|
khilasūktānāṃ nirmāṇakālasteṣāṃ ṛgvedasaṃhitayā bāṣkalādiśākhābhiḥ saṃbandhaścaitasmin viṣaye śephṭeloviṭjhamahāśayaiḥ jarmanabhāṣāyāṃ likhite svīye pustake nibandheṣu ca bahu prapañcitam|
tasya sāro'traivāṅgalabhāṣāyānibaddhāyāṃ prastāvanāyāmuddhṛtaḥ|
śephṭeloviṭjhamahāśayairmudritaṃ kāśmīrakhilagranthamanusṛtya mayātra khilāni saṃgṛhītānīti pūrvamevoktam|
atastebhyaḥ prathamaṃ dhanyavādavitaraṇamucitaṃ manye|
itarāṇi mudritakhilapustakāni anye saṃskṛtagranthāśca khilapāṭhanirdhāraṇe mayopayuktāsteṣāṃ kartāro'pi dhanyavādārhāḥ|
aundhanagarasthāḥ paṃḍita- sātavalekaramahodayāḥ svasaṃpāditaṛgvedaśākalyasaṃhitāpustakadvayamupayogārthaṃ datvā māmupakṛtavanto'- taste viśeṣato dhanyavādārhāḥ|
tathā ca tañjora-tirupanatī-aḍyāra-ityādinagarasthagranthālayagatāni bahūni likhitakhilapustakāni mayā dṛṣṭāni|
teṣāmadhikṛtyebhyo'pi mayā dhanyavādaḥ vitīryante|
āṅgala- jarmanabhāṣayorlikhitāḥ kecana granthā nibandhaśca mayāsya granthasya racanārthamavalokitāsteṣāṃ kartāro'pi dhanyavādārhāḥ|
ante cāsmin khilamudraṇaviṣaye yairvaidvadbhiḥ saṃsūcanena mudritapustakapradānenānya- prakāreṇa vā sāhāyyamāracitaṃ tebhyo'pi dhanyavādān vitarati vidvadvaśaṃvadaḥ ciṃ. ga. kāśīkaraḥ
khilaṭippaṇīṣu nirdiṣṭānāṃ granthānāṃ saṃkṣepasūcī
atharva = atharvavedasaṃhitā anye = anyeṣṭyakaṃ: ( mumbāpurīmudrita: ) bhala = pīṭarsanamahodayaina prakāśitāni ala- varanagarasthilikhitapustakagatāni ṛgvedapari- śiṣṭāni¹. bhāu = āuphresṭamahodayaprakāśitā ṛgvedasaṃhitā ācaṃ = āhnikacandrikā āpagṛ = āpastambagṛhyasūtram āpamaṃ = āpastambamantrapāṭha: āpaśrau = āpastambaśrautasūtram āpāṃnu = āpāṃnukramaṇa ( bibliothikā iṃḍikā seriza , kalakattā ) ādhagṛ = āśvalāyanagṛhyasūtram āśramaṃsaṃ = āśvalāyanamantrasaṃhitā² āśaśrau = āśvalāyanaśrautasūtram āsū = āhnikasūtrāvali: ( mumbāpurīmudritā ) ṛviva = ṛgvividhānam ( lavapure paṃ. jagadīśa- śāstriṇā mudrāpitam, saṃvat 1997 ) ṛprā = ṛgvedaprātiśākhyam ( ḍaॉ. maṃgaladeva- śāstribhi: saṃpāditam ) ṛbha = ṛgvedīyabrahmakarmasamuccaya: ( mumbāpuyāṃ mudrita: ) ṛ
914 khilāni
baudhasū = baudhāyanadharmasūtram gṛhade = bṛhaddevatā (hārvarḍa orieṇṭala sīrīja) mai = maiksamullaramahodayena prakāśitā sabhāṣyā ṛgvedasaṃhitā manāu = mahānārāyaṇopaniṣad maṃdī = mantrārthadīpikā (kāyāṃ prakāśitā) mabhā = mahābhāratam (puṇyapattanastha-bhāṇḍārakara-prācyavidyāsaṃśodhanamandiramudritam) maṃtrā = mantrabrāhmaṇam māgṛ = mānavagṛhyasūtram māmaṃsaṃ = mādhyandinamantrasaṃhitā māśrau = mānavaśrautasūtram mu = mumbāpurīmudritā sabhāṣyā ṛgvedasaṃhitā maisaṃ = maitrāyaṇīsaṃhitā myu = laṇḍananagare briṭiśamyujhīamadhye varta-mānamṛgvedasaṃhitāyā likhitapustakam vāsaṃ = vājasaneyisaṃhitā vipa = vivāhapaddhati: (mumbāpuryāṃ 1886 khristābde mudritā) caisū = vaitānaśrautasūtram śatrā = śatapathabrāhmaṇam
śāṃbhā = śāṅkhāyanāraṇyakam śāṃka = śāṃtikamalākara: śāṃgra = śāṅkhāyanagṛhyasūtram śāṃbrā = śāṅkhāyanabrāhmaṇam śāṃma = śāntimayūkha: (mumbāpuryāṃ 1806 śake mudrita:) śāṃśrau = śāṅkhāyanaśrautasūtram śāṃsā = śāntisāra: (mumbāpuryāṃ 1783 śake mudrita:) śreu = śvetāśvataropaniṣad saṃko = saṃskārakaustubha: (mumbāpuryāṃ khristābde 1861 mudrita:) saṃbhāsa = saṃdhyābhāṣyasamuccaya: (puṇyapattane 1899 khristābde mudrita:) sāma = sāmavedasaṃhitā sāmavitrā = sāmavidhānabrāhmaṇam supa = suparṇādhyāya: higu = hiraṇyakeśagṛhyasūtram hiśrau = hiraṇyakeśaśrautasūtram hisaṃdhyā = hiraṇyakeśatrikālasaṃdhyā (mumbā-purīmudritā)
